result.instructions: Tools for Refersion, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which affiliates signed up this week and are still waiting for approval?"; "Show me the recent activity of affiliate 8963614."; "Find the conversion with id 1234 and tell me its status and commission.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Refersion data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run refersion_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run refersion_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run refersion_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. refersion_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: refersion_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List affiliates of the merchant account, with profile, offer and performance metrics. Filter by status (pending, approved, denied), a search term, or offer ids. Paged with page and limit. GET /v2026-08/affiliates.

offer_ids.description: Only affiliates on these offer ids.

tools.name: refersion_get_affiliate_activity
tools.title: Get affiliate activity
tools.description: Get the weekly conversion, payment and click activity of one affiliate, newest first, capped at 10 entries. GET /v2026-08/affiliates/{id}/activity.

tools.name: refersion_get_affiliate_link
tools.title: Get affiliate tracking link
tools.description: Generate the tracking link of one affiliate. GET /v2026-08/affiliates/{id}/link.

tools.name: refersion_get_affiliate_custom_fields
tools.title: Get affiliate custom fields
tools.description: List the custom field values of one affiliate. GET /v2026-08/affiliates/{id}/custom-fields.

tools.name: refersion_get_conversion
tools.title: Get conversion detail
tools.description: Get the full detail of one conversion: affiliate, offer, click, payment method and status. GET /v2026-08/conversions/{id}.

tools.name: refersion_list_prospects
tools.title: List affiliate prospects
tools.description: List affiliate partner prospects found for the merchant. Only reads what is ready; it starts no new discovery job. GET /v2026-08/prospects.

tools.name: refersion_resend_welcome_email
tools.title: Resend affiliate welcome email
tools.description: Send the welcome email again to one affiliate. It emails the affiliate; Refersion allows one resend per 15 minutes. POST /v2026-08/affiliates/{id}/welcome-email.
